There are more Darkspear at the fires of Sen'jin than last week.

addressed: The hero cleansed the Wildmane Water Well that the Venture Co. had poisoned.
The hero did the tauren of Bloodhoof Village a great service.
The hero healed the water of northern Mulgore.
recounted: Someone cleansed the poisoned Wildmane Water Well.
The kodos of Mulgore drink from the Wildmane Well without sickness.
The children of Bloodhoof Village are sent to fetch water from the northern wells again.

addressed: The hero slew Ursal the Mauler, who led the Gnarlpine furbolgs astray.
The hero woke the sleeping Druids of the Talon.
The hero brought peace to the forest around Gnarlpine Hold.
recounted: Someone killed Ursal the Mauler in Teldrassil.
The Druids of the Talon walk the paths of Dolanaar again.
The owls have returned to the forest around Gnarlpine Hold.

addressed: The hero slew the satyr who corrupted the Blackwood furbolgs.
The hero did Thundris Windweaver of Auberdine a great service.
The hero began to free the Blackwood furbolgs from their madness.
recounted: Someone killed the satyr who drove the Blackwood furbolgs mad.
Some Blackwood furbolgs have been seen without the madness in their eyes.
The Blackwood furbolgs no longer charge the road to Auberdine on sight.

addressed: The hero slew Warlord Krom'zar and broke the Kolkar counterattack.
The hero defended the Horde bunkers in the Barrens.
The hero did Regthar Deathgate a great service.
recounted: Someone killed Warlord Krom'zar of the Kolkar centaur.
The Kolkar who came from Desolace have fled back west.
The Crossroads caravans no longer need extra guards on the western road.

addressed: The hero slew Murgut, king of the Foulweald furbolgs.
The hero did Karang Amakkar of Zoram'gar Outpost a great service.
The hero made the woods of Ashenvale a little safer for the Horde.
recounted: Someone killed Murgut, king of the Foulweald.
The Foulweald furbolgs have pulled back deep into the woods southeast of Astranaar.
Horde scouts pass the Foulweald village without a fight.

addressed: The hero killed Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, the Venture Co. foreman at Windshear Crag.
The hero did the goblin Ziz Fizziks a great service.
The hero slowed the Venture Co.'s logging in Stonetalon.
recounted: Someone killed Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle at Windshear Crag.
The Venture Co. shredders at Windshear Crag cut slower now.
The first saplings have come up on the northern slope of Windshear Crag.

addressed: The hero protected Kanati Greycloud from the Galak centaur's assassins.
The hero foiled the Galak centaur's plot near Freewind Post.
The hero fought at Kanati Greycloud's side.
recounted: Someone stopped the Galak centaur from assassinating Kanati Greycloud.
The elders of Freewind Post say centaur raids on the lower canyon trails have slowed.
The wind riders of Freewind Post fly out with fewer warnings.

addressed: The hero slew Ran Bloodtooth, chieftain of the Thistlefur furbolgs.
The hero helped Raene Wolfrunner rebuild Dartol's rod.
The hero made the road to Astranaar safer.
recounted: Someone killed Ran Bloodtooth of the Thistlefur.
The Thistlefur furbolgs are leaderless and quarrel among themselves.
The Sentinels have begun to talk of reclaiming the paths near Thistlefur Village.

addressed: The hero killed Tethyr, the sea monster that threatened the Theramore docks.
The hero did Major Mills of Theramore a great service.
The hero made the Theramore harbor safe for ships.
recounted: Someone killed the sea monster Tethyr off the Theramore docks.
Ships have been arriving at Theramore on schedule again.
The Theramore dockhands no longer refuse night shifts.

addressed: The hero found the Grimtotem who attacked the Shady Rest Inn.
The hero brought justice to the Grimtotem behind the Shady Rest attack.
The hero helped keep the peace between the Horde and Theramore.
recounted: Someone dealt with the Grimtotem who burned the Shady Rest Inn.
Theramore has eased its patrols near the Horde's borders in Dustwallow Marsh.
The Grimtotem of Dustwallow Marsh have gone quiet for now.

addressed: The hero brought the Mirage Raceway team the booster that kept their car in one piece.
The hero helped the goblins and gnomes of the Mirage Raceway.
The hero made racing on the Shimmering Flats a little safer.
recounted: A new booster got a Mirage Raceway car all the way around the track without exploding.
Crowds are coming back to the Shimmering Flats to watch the races.
The gnome racers say they'll win next season, as they do every season.

addressed: The hero killed Khan Hratha, leader of the Maraudine centaur.
The hero fought for one of the centaur clans of Desolace.
The hero turned the centaur war in Desolace.
recounted: Someone killed Khan Hratha of the Maraudine centaur.
The Maraudine centaur have pulled back into the Valley of Spears.
The other centaur clans of Desolace think twice before raiding the herds of their rivals.

addressed: The hero broke the Wastewander bandits who robbed Gadgetzan's water caravans.
The hero did Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle of Gadgetzan a great service.
The hero made the roads of Tanaris safer for water caravans.
recounted: Someone broke the Wastewander bandits of Tanaris.
Fewer water barrels go missing on the road to Gadgetzan.
The price of water at the Gadgetzan tap has gone down by a copper.

addressed: The hero pushed the Gordunni ogres back from the old night elf ruins of Feralas.
The hero did Rok Orhan of Camp Mojache a great service.
The hero made the High Wilderness safer for the Horde.
recounted: Someone drove the Gordunni ogres from the night elf ruins of the High Wilderness.
The withered trees in the High Wilderness ruins are putting out new leaves.
